<thought>We need to find the retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target sulfonamide molecule (Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1), yields the precursors aniline (c1ccccc1N) and the sulfonyl aryl fragment. This corresponds to breaking a sulfonamide bond, so we search for templates that break the "sulfonamides" functional group.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{"molecule_smiles": "Cc1ccc(NS(=O)(=O)c2ccc(/C=C/C(=O)O)cc2)cc1", "functional_groups_broken": ["sulfonamides"], "limit": 5}</action_input>
